notes: Hotkeys are sent to the CLIENT WINDOW, not handled globally, unless 'global_hotkeys' is true.
SendInput uses scancodes (KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE) to survive clients that ignore virtual-key events.
Every module honors 'stop_on_death' and the shared stop event from context.py.

healer.note: Hysteresis pair: heal below threshold, stop at above_threshold, prevents hotkey spam oscillation.

auto_food.note: Jitter prevents a metronomic eating pattern. Pause while critical so healer gets the input bus.

cavebot.note: walk_mode 'key_hold' sends direction scancodes for key_hold_ms and re-checks position from memory. 'click_tile' needs calibrated tile_map and stays off until offsets land.

auto_target.note: target_mode 'attack_hotkey' presses the client's attack key on a selected creature. 'click_creature' needs calibrated screen projection, added later.

auto_catch.note: Waits for target death flag in memory, then fires the configured ball hotkey throw_count times with jittered delay.

alarms.note: disconnect grace avoids false positives during normal loading screens.

notify.note: Left disabled by default. Fill the URL and flip enabled when you want Discord pings.

hotkeys.note: panic_stop works even when the client doesn't have focus. F12 immediately sets the shared stop event and releases all held keys.

notes: input_bus_queue_max is a hard cap; overflow drops the request and logs, never blocks a module thread.
min_interval_between_inputs_ms is enforced inside inputbus so two modules can't stroke the client even if a priority bug slips through.
